enable_vllm_auto_round_extension: set VLLM_ENABLE_AR_EXT environment variable to 1 to enable the auto round vllm extension
disable_vllm_auto_round_extension: set VLLM_ENABLE_AR_EXT environment variable to empty string to skip the auto round vllm extension
patch_autoround_config: replace the vllm AutoRoundConfig class with AutoRoundExtensionConfig when the extension is enabled
load_extra_environment_variables: import extra_environment_variables from envs_ext module when the auto round extension is active
review_sitecustomize: review the sitecustomize module that conditionally patches vllm quantization config based on an environment variable
